name: Ministry Fit & Gifting
model: Dual-axis spiritual gifts — reduced from 27 gifts to 12 serving/helps-relevant gifts
format: per gift: 1 Passion item + 1 Evidence item, each 1-5
output: Rank gifts by total; top gifts + quadrant label; map to usher role. Role map carried into BOTH candidate and pastoral reports.

Helps & Service.P: I genuinely enjoy practical tasks that support others behind the scenes.
Helps & Service.E: People regularly rely on me to get practical things done, and I follow through.

Hospitality.P: I love making people feel welcome and at ease.
Hospitality.E: Others have told me they felt genuinely welcomed because of me.

Mercy.P: I am drawn to comfort people who are hurting or distressed.
Mercy.E: People in pain often seek me out because I show real compassion.

Administration.P: I enjoy organising people, tasks and details so things run smoothly.
Administration.E: I have a track record of keeping things orderly and well-coordinated.

Leadership.P: I am energised by taking responsibility and guiding a team toward a goal.
Leadership.E: Others naturally look to me to take the lead, and they follow.

Discernment.P: I pay close attention to what is really going on beneath the surface.
Discernment.E: My read on people and situations has repeatedly proven accurate.

Encouragement.P: I love building others up and spurring them on.
Encouragement.E: People say they feel strengthened after talking with me.

Faith.P: I readily trust God for things others find hard to believe.
Faith.E: My confidence in God has held steady and encouraged others in hard times.

Giving.P: I find real joy in giving generously of my time and resources.
Giving.E: I consistently give beyond what is expected of me.

Intercession.P: I am drawn to pray earnestly and persistently for others.
Intercession.E: I have kept praying for people and situations over long periods.

Shepherding.P: I care about walking alongside people over time as they grow.
Shepherding.E: I have faithfully supported and guided others in their journey.

Evangelism & Follow-Up.P: I love connecting with newcomers and helping them take a next step.
Evangelism & Follow-Up.E: I have helped new or unconnected people become settled and connected.
